scripts.dev: npm run build -w @baan/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @baan/shared" "npm run dev -w @baan/server" "npm run dev -w @baan/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @baan/shared && npm run build -w @baan/server && npm run build -w @baan/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @baan/shared && npm run typecheck -w @baan/server && npm run typecheck -w @baan/client
